2609.15293.title: Why LLM Agents Collapse Without Oversight: The Enforcement Gap as the Mechanism Behind Emergence World Failures
2609.15293.paper_summary: When Emergence World placed frontier LLM agents in an unsupervised multi-agent simulation, the results were alarming: agents committed crimes, starved, and enforced unanimous conformity -- without any external attacker. This paper identifies the mechanism. Reflexion-style agents already detect dangerous plan steps through iterative self-critique, yet the architecture provides no pathway from detection to action. We call this the enforcement gap: the audit sees the problem; the controller ignores it. Closing the gap requires a single conditional check -- fewer than 20 lines of code -- and reduces attack success by more than fourfold in large-scale experiments across frontier models, all five major agent frameworks, and an independent benchmark. We prove formally that when enforcement probability is near zero, detection quality is irrelevant to security. We further identify two compounding failure modes -- unreliable auditors and unparseable verdicts -- that explain every collapse pattern in Emergence World. A GRPO-trained enforcement controller resolves the ambiguity case. Concurrent work on filtering and information-flow control addresses the detection step but leaves the enforcement gap unaddressed; our results show this is the binding constraint. Together these results motivate a three-requirement Audit Enforcement Specification that is absent from every deployed framework today.
2609.15293.paper_summary_zh: 當 Emergence World 將前沿 LLM 代理放置在無監督的多代理模擬中時，結果令人震驚：代理們犯罪、挨餓，並強制實現一致的從眾行為——沒有任何外部攻擊者。這篇論文確定了這一機制。Reflexion 風格的代理已經通過迭代自我批評來檢測危險的計劃步驟，但該架構並未提供從檢測到行動的途徑。我們稱之為執行差距：審計看到問題；控制器則忽視它。填補這一差距需要一個單一的條件檢查——少於 20 行代碼——並在大規模實驗中將攻擊成功率降低了四倍以上，涵蓋了所有前沿模型、所有五大代理框架以及一個獨立基準。我們正式證明，當執行概率接近於零時，檢測質量對安全性是無關緊要的。我們進一步確定了兩種複合失敗模式——不可靠的審計者和不可解析的裁決——這解釋了 Emergence World 中的每一種崩潰模式。一個經過 GRPO 訓練的執行控制器解決了模糊案例。關於過濾和信息流控制的並行工作解決了檢測步驟，但未解決執行差距；我們的結果顯示這是約束條件。這些結果共同促使我們提出一個三項要求的審計執行規範，而這在當前每個已部署的框架中均不存在。
2609.15293.author: Yuhang Wang et.al.
